Example demonstrates humbling someone psychologically, but current selected sense is placing oneself below another in status. Prefer a clear self-humbling/subordinating context and matching Korean.
Selected hull sense is peeling skin/shell; strawberry calyx removal is another use. Use hulling grain with matched Korean.

Selected ecology is the pattern of organism/environment relationships. Current sentence uses ecology as the scientific discipline/research field. Rewrite with forest/ecosystem ecology as subject or object, with matched Korean.
Selected quarantine means isolation/restricted movement to prevent infection. Korean 검역 is inspection, not quarantine. Use a direct isolation context with 격리.
Korean 고향 means hometown, but the English homeland and selected patriotism refer to one's country. Use 조국의 자연환경.
Makes the job handy is not idiomatic. Use handy modifying a method/device or way, retaining selected easy/simple sense and matched Korean.
Selected underwater noun meaning subsurface water is unusual; primary-source attestation requested from parent before approval. Current wording sampled the cold underwater needs confirmation.
Use in brackets / inside brackets, since two marks enclose the text; singular inside a bracket is unnatural. Update literal focus to brackets.
Korean 정자는 난자와 수정할 수 있다 is not natural scientific phrasing. Use 정자는 난자를 수정시킬 수 있다 to match sperm can fertilise an egg.
Prefer standard idiom looked like a walking skeleton rather than looked a walking skeleton. Current sentence is stilted for a general learner example.
Gore specifically pierces/wounds with a horn/tusk. Korean 뿔로 들이받다 can merely mean butt; convey 뿔로 찔러 다치게 하다 to preserve the distinction.
For a syllable onset, use Korean 초성 / 음절 첫머리 rather than 두음, which normally denotes word-initial sound. Suggested 그 음절의 초성은 자음 두 개로 이루어져 있다.
English hooker is gender-neutral in this bound sense; Korean adds 여성 without source support. Use 성매매 종사자 to retain the original unspecified gender.
Korean 흡연의 유행 정도 sounds like fashion; use 흡연율 or how widespread smoking is, matching prevalence.
My head felt buzzing is an awkward collocation; use an idiomatic adjectival buzzing-head context with matched Korean.
Keep the English word forms happiness and happy in quotation marks in Korean, rather than rendering lexical objects as 해피니스 and 해피.
Her spirits began to refresh is unidiomatic. Use an attested intransitive rest/regain-energy context.
Selected scarlet is a noun. Paint the door scarlet reads as adjective; use colour as an explicit noun subject/object.
Selected crimson is a noun; turned clouds crimson reads as predicative adjective. Use a clear noun colour context.
Korean 보육인 is an uncommon phrasing for nanny here; use 보모 or a natural child-carer description.
Korean 날가금육 is an awkward invented compound; use 익히지 않은 가금육 for raw poultry.
Selected cruising is a noun activity, but cruising speed reads as modifier. Use a clear nominal activity subject/object.
Selected notation is representation of speech in characters/signs. Musical notation uses a separate domain; use a phonetic/speech-sound notation context with matched Korean.
Korean 황소 normally means bull, while ox here is a working bovine. Use 일소 to retain the working-animal sense naturally.
Korean 경고를 들어 주세요 sounds merely hear/listen; heed means pay attention/follow. Prefer 경고를 귀담아들으세요 or 유념하세요.
Korean 맹목적으로 보지 않아 is awkward negative scope. Convey his uncritical inability to recognise her faults as the cause of trouble.
Selected violet is a noun, but sky turned violet is predicative adjective; use a clear noun colour context.
Use ivory as an explicit noun colour rather than ivory colour, whose modifier reads as adjective.
